answer.text:
The **Redragon Fizz K617** (approx. ₹2,200–₹2,600) is the best overall mechanical keyboard under ₹3,000 featuring hot-swappable switches.

It offers strong build quality, bright RGB lighting, hot-swappable Outemu red linear switches (smooth and quiet for gaming/typing), and standard keycap stem compatibility for easy customization.

---

| Model | Form Factor | Switch Type | Connection | Key Highlights | Approx. Price |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Redragon Fizz K617** | 60% Compact | Outemu Red (Linear) | Detachable USB-C | Best overall modding potential, software support, compact setup | ₹2,300 |
| **Redragon Kumara K552** | TKL (87 Keys) | Outemu Red/Blue | Wired USB | Heavy-duty build, metal top plate, preferred if you need arrow keys | ₹2,700 |
| **Kreo Hive** | 75% or Full-size | Outemu Red/Brown | Wired USB | Includes dedicated arrow/media keys, clean design | ₹2,699 |
| **EvoFox Ronin TKL** | TKL (87 Keys) | Outemu Red | Wired USB | Tactile volume knob, decent RGB lighting | ₹2,800 |

---

### Important Buyer Notes

* **Hot-Swap Compatibility:** Most sub-₹3000 hot-swappable boards use **3-pin Outemu sockets**. They are directly compatible with Outemu, Akko, KTT, and Gazew/Bobba switches, but standard 5-pin Cherry, Gateron, or Kailh switches require clipping off the extra 2 plastic legs to fit.
* **Red vs. Blue Switches:** Choose **Red switches** for smooth, quiet typing and quick gaming responses, or **Blue switches** if you prefer a loud, tactile click.
